dataset.source_note: Dataset images span the manufacturing process. Gate8D therefore uses contiguous source-index blocks, not a random image split.

split_rule.train: first 70 percent by numeric source index within each class
split_rule.val: next 15 percent by numeric source index within each class
split_rule.test: remaining 15 percent by numeric source index within each class

quality_policy.reason: This dataset is small and contains process-sequence images. Held-out metrics screen the replacement candidate but do not establish production or X1C-camera generalization.
